full_judgment: Md Ashfaqul Islam J : At the instance of the petitioner, Amzad Hossain, this Rule Nisi was issued calling upon the respondents to show cause as to why the impugned Memo No. Baimuni (LD A-1) 144/278/2004-677 dated 4-4-2004 (Annexure-D) cancelling the Money Changer License of the petitioner issued by Foreign Exchange Policy Division, Bangladesh Bank at the signature of the respondent No. 4 should not be declared to have been made and issued without lawful authority and is of no legal effect.
